about: Traditional astrology and numerology meanings, kept short, positive and general. Nothing here predicts health, accidents, marriage, exams or money.

western.name: Western astrology (tropical zodiac)
western.note: The 12 signs are based on where the Sun appeared against the stars at birth, as worked out about 2,000 years ago. Because the Earth's axis slowly wobbles, the real star patterns have since shifted by almost a whole sign.

numerology.name: Numerology (birth number)
numerology.note: Add every digit of the date of birth, again and again, until one digit is left. The meanings of 1 to 9 come from modern popular numerology.

chinese.name: Chinese zodiac
chinese.note: Twelve animals, one for each year in a 12-year cycle. The year starts at the Lunar New Year, between 21 January and 20 February.

signs.name: Capricorn
signs.text: Tradition says Capricorns are patient climbers who finish what they start. You may enjoy making a plan and ticking it off step by step.

signs.name: Aquarius
signs.text: Tradition says Aquarians are inventors with original ideas. You may enjoy asking “what if?” and trying things a new way.

signs.name: Pisces
signs.text: Tradition says Pisceans are kind dreamers with big imaginations. You may notice how other people feel and enjoy stories and music.

signs.name: Aries
signs.text: Tradition says Aries people are brave starters who like to go first. You may enjoy a challenge and cheering others on.

signs.name: Taurus
signs.text: Tradition says Taureans are calm and steady, and they love good food and nature. You may be the friend others can rely on.

signs.name: Gemini
signs.text: Tradition says Geminis are curious talkers who love learning new facts. You may enjoy puzzles, jokes and big conversations.

signs.name: Cancer
signs.text: Tradition says Cancerians are caring and loyal to family and friends. You may make people feel at home.

signs.name: Leo
signs.text: Tradition says Leos are warm and confident, with a big heart. You may enjoy leading a team or performing on a stage.

signs.name: Virgo
signs.text: Tradition says Virgos are careful and helpful and notice small details. You may enjoy making things neat and correct.

signs.name: Libra
signs.text: Tradition says Librans are fair and friendly and love balance. You may be good at helping two sides agree.

signs.name: Scorpio
signs.text: Tradition says Scorpios are determined and loyal, with deep feelings. You may enjoy solving mysteries.

signs.name: Sagittarius
signs.text: Tradition says Sagittarians are cheerful explorers who love adventure. You may enjoy travel, sport and big questions.

1.name: the leader
1.text: Number 1 is called the leader: someone who likes to start new things.

2.name: the peacemaker
2.text: Number 2 is called the peacemaker: someone who is good at teamwork.

3.name: the creator
3.text: Number 3 is called the creator: someone who enjoys art, words and fun.

4.name: the builder
4.text: Number 4 is called the builder: someone who likes order and hard work.

5.name: the adventurer
5.text: Number 5 is called the adventurer: someone who loves change and freedom.

6.name: the helper
6.text: Number 6 is called the helper: someone who cares for others.

7.name: the thinker
7.text: Number 7 is called the thinker: someone who likes deep questions.

8.name: the organiser
8.text: Number 8 is called the organiser: someone who likes big goals.

9.name: the dreamer
9.text: Number 9 is called the dreamer: someone who wants to make the world kinder.

animals.name: Rat
animals.text: The Rat is said to be quick-thinking and clever.

animals.name: Ox
animals.text: The Ox is said to be strong, patient and hard-working.

animals.name: Tiger
animals.text: The Tiger is said to be brave and full of energy.

animals.name: Rabbit
animals.text: The Rabbit is said to be gentle, kind and polite.

animals.name: Dragon
animals.text: The Dragon is said to be confident and full of ideas.

animals.name: Snake
animals.text: The Snake is said to be wise and calm.

animals.name: Horse
animals.text: The Horse is said to be lively and love freedom.

animals.name: Goat
animals.text: The Goat is said to be creative and caring.

animals.name: Monkey
animals.text: The Monkey is said to be playful and smart.

animals.name: Rooster
animals.text: The Rooster is said to be honest and hard-working.

animals.name: Dog
animals.text: The Dog is said to be loyal and fair.

animals.name: Pig
animals.text: The Pig is said to be generous and friendly.
